steps.note: S5.1.2 states the net target change (JV+RG)x independent of the initial side and central values a,c, and S5.1.1 gives the subtract/introduce/restore role of the rows, matching 744-750.
S5.1.3 gives the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, the side injection cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, zero for intersections zero or two, and self coefficient one.
S5.1.4 gives the complex central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, cancelled by the side for distinct triples with intersection zero or two, intersection one contributing zero, self coefficient one.

S5.2 describes the forward/inverse/forward stages sending (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) while restoring every auxiliary value, and quotes line 763 with the intermediate states (x,y+x), (-y,y+x), (-y,x) as its support.
S5.4.4 only says every edge joins comparable labels and names the decreasing center edge; the per-edge orthogonal residuals and their dimensions (the residual table) are never given.

S5.4.3 gives t_X perp t_Y implies <t_X> subset t_Y^perp, but omits the complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2 that is the side edge 2->5 residual, so the sub-step is only half stated (absent by the unsure rule).
The plan states that the only decreasing edges are center 3->4 losing h, sources sum to N and sinks to Wm-N, signed changes telescope to Wm-2N, and absolute changes give Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich.

The plan uses orthonormal residual bases (S5.5, S5.5.1) but never argues that each nonzero binary residual is nondegenerate and nonalternating, nor the absorption of alternating planes giving the orthonormal basis.
S5.4.6 states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 with the line 1107 quote.
S5.5.1 gives the weight identity, additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, and q_V-q_U as the sum of wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal residual basis.

S5.5.2 states norm one gives odd weight, the phase i^{eps[v.x]} as the two-term expression, and that conjugating by H^{tensor m} turns it into aI+bX_v or its inverse, a faithful paraphrase of H diag(1,-1) H = X.

The plan counts one kernel per basis vector (S5.5.3) and one child call per basis vector on a slot (S5.11.1, S5.11.4), but never states the k-column tensor-power factorization making each residual vector one tensored factor across columns.

S5.5.4 gives the exceptional pair X_a->Y_a with C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates and the identity C=iZC^{-1}Z, but omits the zero-label frame I and full-label frame C^{tensor m}, the explicit Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} corrections (only 'sign and phase corrections') and the negation of the X outputs (absent by the unsure rule).
The plan states both loss ratios are below 1/2 and that the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 give s<Wm.
The plan states both deficits exceed 20*2^-50, log m<20 gives m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-20*2^-50)>m(1-eta), hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^-50.
S5.7 asserts the factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 with exactly a ones but gives none of the elimination proof (topmost row's rightmost pivot, lower-triangular clearing, repetition on active indices).

S5.8 only asserts that a fixed odd prime exists; it never says the prime is chosen to avoid every denominator in a finite factor table so the identities specialize to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors.
S5.8.1 states a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order using earlier coordinates still holding their original values.
S5.8.3 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j with one interchange per one of Pi, and S5.8.4 gives a interchanges in all.
The plan defines E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu=min{j>=1: m^j>=B}, C_1=max{20,nu+3}, C_0=128mB^2 and Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}), with C_1=20 in S8.1.1 (the value nu=11 is not stated).
S5.11.7.1 states A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E at an internal node and A(e)<=8e at a leaf, with E bounding the gates and corrections of one invocation, and S5.11.7.2 explains the use of s.
The plan unrolls with sx+E<=Bx, gets B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu and A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}, and bounds the total by 128mB^2 d^{nu+3}<=C_0 d^{C_1}.
S5.11.7.7 states depth-ell values lie in 2^{-(p+ell)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^ell so p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits suffice, and S5.11.7.8 that epsilon C_1<1 gives Delta=o(p).
S5.11.8.3 states every row of H has absolute row sum one so disks are preserved, and S5.11.8.4 that truncation errs by less than sqrt2 2^-p.

summary: P02 states 19 of 26 sub-steps. It covers the bank-exchange lemma fully (B1-B4), the rank saving fully (R1-R4), the guard-width bound fully (S1-S5), and the label budget's telescoping and loss ratios (L3, L5), the phase weight-additivity and kernel steps (P1, P2) and the shear's triangular cost and interchange trick (M3, M4). Absent: the residual table (L1), the h-2 complement on side edge 2->5 (L2), the nonalternating/orthonormal-basis argument (L4), the k-column tensoring (P3), the endpoint frames with explicit Z_{a,k}/i^{27k} corrections and X negation (P4), the elimination proof of A=E_1 Pi E_2 (M1), and the denominator-avoiding prime (M2). No sub-step is stated contrary to the paper.
